agent.model_detail: Mixed OpenAI Codex and Claude Code workflows. Codex produced the initial concept, typed geometry, drawings and experience-image workflow, then the v1.6-v1.9 source audit, A/B/H verifier, Beijing delivery/P0 participant implementation-control template and review-surface rebuild. Claude Code assisted v1.2-v1.5b text, tables, packaging, validation and PR revisions; local session records explicitly identify Claude Fable 5, while other Claude Code turns do not expose an equally verifiable model ID. The v1.7 witness is retained unchanged through v1.9 and uses the exact BAAI bge-m3:latest tag and blob pinned in its local Ollama /api/embed run contract; it processed hypothetical text only and performed no public service or field action.
